menu_options.bridge: Hue bridge (from the Philips Hue integration)

bridge.title: Choose a Hue bridge
bridge.description: Hue Studio reuses the connection of the Philips Hue integration, so no extra pairing is needed.

sync_box.title: Hue Play HDMI Sync Box
sync_box.description: Recommended: pair the box directly with Hue Studio — all features, its own entities. Compatibility mode: use a box the HACS Sync Box integration already has — nothing to pair, but only what that integration exposes. One box is used one way only.

menu_options.sync_box_integration: Use the Sync Box integration (compatibility mode)

sync_box_pair.title: Hue Play HDMI Sync Box
sync_box_pair.description: Enter the address of the Sync Box. You will then hold its button to pair it with Hue Studio. Already using the Sync Box integration from HACS? Hue Studio can also work through it (compatibility mode): it is offered here once that integration has the box.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the Sync Box in your network.

sync_box_integration.title: Compatibility mode: Sync Box integration
sync_box_integration.description: Hue Studio uses the entities and service of the Sync Box integration for this box: nothing to pair, and its entities stay as they are. Limits: entertainment areas are matched by name, input types and some details are not available, and new Hue Studio features for the Sync Box need direct pairing. To switch later, remove the box from the Sync Box integration and pair it with Hue Studio.

sync_box_use_integration.title: {name}
sync_box_use_integration.description: {name} is already set up in the Sync Box integration ({entry}). Hue Studio can use it through that integration (compatibility mode): nothing to pair, but only what the integration exposes. For direct pairing (recommended, all features), cancel here, remove the box from the Sync Box integration and add it again.

sync_box_confirm.title: {name}
sync_box_confirm.description: Pair {name} with Hue Studio? Next, you will hold the button on the box.

sync_box_retry.title: {name}
sync_box_retry.description: Make sure the box is on, then try again and hold its button until the LED blinks green.

reauth_confirm.title: {name}
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts Hue Studio (it may have been reset). Pair it again by holding its button.

apply_palette.name: Apply palette
apply_palette.description: Applies a palette to Hue lights: gradient lights get the whole palette, other lights one color each.

palette.name: Palette
palette.description: gallery:<id>, b64:<base64 JSON palette> or a gallery scene id.

gallery_scene.name: Gallery scene
gallery_scene.description: ID of a scene from the bundled gallery.

mirek.name: White temperature
mirek.description: Color temperature in mired, for a white palette.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness in percent. Defaults to the palette's own brightness.

mode.name: Gradient mode
mode.description: How gradient lights lay the colors out (when they support it).

layout.name: Layout
layout.description: Classic: colors in turn over the lights. Spatial: colors by where the lights stand in the room (positions from entertainment areas or the panel).

set_gradient.name: Set gradient
set_gradient.description: Sets the color points of Hue gradient lights.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: How the points are spread over the light.

set_effect.name: Set effect
set_effect.description: Plays a light effect (candle, fireplace, sparkle, …) with its color, speed and brightness.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: The effect to play; No effect stops it.

xy_color.name: Color
xy_color.description: CIE xy color of the effect, e.g. [0.55, 0.4].

mirek.name: White temperature
mirek.description: Color temperature of the effect in mired.

create_scene.name: Create scene
create_scene.description: Creates a scene in a Hue room or zone, visible in the Hue app. From a gallery scene or palette (spread over the lights and stored for dynamic play and shuffle), otherwise from what the lights show now.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the new scene (unique in the room or zone).

gallery_scene.name: Gallery scene
gallery_scene.description: Id of a gallery scene; its colors and picture are used.

points.name: Colors
points.description: Palette colors as CIE xy points.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness of the palette in percent.

delete_scene.name: Delete scene
delete_scene.description: Deletes Hue scenes from the bridge (and so from the Hue app).

create_zone.name: Create zone
create_zone.description: Creates a Hue zone of the targeted lights (for example all Hue lights of an area), so the area gets scenes of its own. Returns the new zone_id.

save_scene.name: Save scene
save_scene.description: Stores what the scene's lights show now in the Hue scene; optionally renames it and sets its dynamic speed and auto-play.

speed.name: Dynamic speed
speed.description: Speed of the dynamic scene in percent.

auto_dynamic.name: Auto-play
auto_dynamic.description: Start the scene dynamically whenever it is activated.

reset_scene.name: Reset scene
reset_scene.description: Rebuilds the light settings of a Hue scene from its palette and activates it.

shuffle.name: Shuffle colors
shuffle.description: Spread the palette colors over the lights in random order.

recall_scene.name: Play scene
recall_scene.description: Activates a Hue scene dynamically (colors keep changing) or statically, regardless of its auto-play setting.

dynamic.name: Dynamic
dynamic.description: Play the scene's palette dynamically; off shows it statically.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.description: Brightness in percent instead of the scene's own.

set_sync.name: Set Sync Box
set_sync.description: Changes a Hue Play HDMI Sync Box in one command: power, light sync, mode, intensity, HDMI input, entertainment area, brightness, music palette, background lighting or a preset.

power.name: Power
power.description: On: HDMI passes through; off: power save.

sync.name: Light sync
sync.description: Start or stop syncing the lights.

mode.name: Sync mode
mode.description: Video, music or game; picking a mode starts syncing in it.

input.name: HDMI input
input.description: input1-input4 or the name you gave the input.

entertainment_area.name: Entertainment area
entertainment_area.description: Name or id of the entertainment area to sync.

palette.name: Music palette
palette.description: Colors of music mode (directly paired boxes only).

background_lighting.name: Background lighting
background_lighting.description: Light the room softly around video or game sync (directly paired boxes only).

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Name or id of a preset of the box to start (directly paired boxes only).

auto_light_exclude.name: Auto light: exclude scene
auto_light_exclude.description: Never (or again) pick a gallery scene in an area's auto light.

excluded.name: Excluded
excluded.description: Off to pick the scene again.

auto_light_pool.name: Auto light: set pool
auto_light_pool.description: Sets the gallery scenes of one pool of an area's auto light.

step.name: Pool
step.description: clear or gloomy; for the day phase the brightness step 0-3.

auto_light_offset.name: Auto light: brightness offset
auto_light_offset.description: Shifts the brightness of a phase by the given percent; 0 resets it. Returns the new offset.

delta.name: Change
delta.description: Percent to add; 0 resets the offset.

import_legacy.name: Import legacy settings
import_legacy.description: Imports the auto light of rooms from a legacy lights.json; rooms are matched to areas by id or name. Returns what was imported.

path.name: File
path.description: Path relative to the config directory.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace areas that already have auto light settings.

align_rooms.name: Align rooms with areas
align_rooms.description: Brings the Hue rooms on the bridge in line with the Home Assistant areas: every area with Hue lights gets a Hue room of its name with exactly those lights. Returns the plan; with a target, only the targeted lights are moved.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Only return the plan, change nothing.

complete_scenes.name: Complete scenes
complete_scenes.description: Give the scenes of a room actions for the lights that joined it: from the scene's palette, else copied from a neighboring light.

delete_empty_rooms.name: Delete empty rooms
delete_empty_rooms.description: Delete Hue rooms left without lights that no area uses. Their scenes are deleted with them.

keep_split_scenes.name: Keep scenes of split rooms
keep_split_scenes.description: When a Hue room's lights go to several areas, first copy its scenes that would lose lights into a new Hue zone over the room's lights (named after the room, or after the areas when that name stays with a room).

update_zone.name: Update zone
update_zone.description: Renames a Hue zone or gives it other lights.

lights.name: Lights
lights.description: All lights of the zone (replaces the current ones).

delete_zone.name: Delete zone
delete_zone.description: Deletes Hue zones from the bridge, together with their scenes.

apply_auto_light.name: Apply auto light
apply_auto_light.description: Shows the area's scene of the day at its auto brightness on the area's Hue lights. Does nothing while someone controls the lights by hand or auto light is off, unless forced.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Seconds to fade into the scene.

force.name: Force
force.description: Apply even while the lights are under manual control or auto light is off.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Hand lights under manual control back to auto light first (e.g. when someone enters the room).

save_sync_preset.name: Save Sync Box preset
save_sync_preset.description: Saves what a directly paired Sync Box does now (mode, settings, input, entertainment area, brightness) as a preset of the box.

delete_sync_preset.name: Delete Sync Box preset
delete_sync_preset.description: Deletes a preset of a directly paired Sync Box.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Name or id of the preset.

learn_sync_ir_code.name: Learn a remote button
learn_sync_ir_code.description: A directly paired Sync Box listens for one remote button (20 seconds); its code then shows in the panel.

set_sync_ir_code.name: Set a remote button
set_sync_ir_code.description: Makes a remote button do something on a directly paired Sync Box.

code.name: Code
code.description: The button's code (hex) the box learned.

action.name: Action
action.description: toggle_sync, sync_on, sync_off, power_off, passthrough, mode_video, mode_music, mode_game, next_mode, next_input, next_intensity, brighter, darker, toggle_background, input:input1-4 or preset:<name or id>.

delete_sync_ir_code.name: Forget a remote button
delete_sync_ir_code.description: Removes a remote button from a directly paired Sync Box.

menu_options.groups: Hue rooms and zones → HA areas

groups.title: Hue rooms and zones → HA areas
groups.description: Each Hue room or zone on the left, the Home Assistant area it belongs to on the right. Filled in automatically when an area has exactly the same lights; leave a row empty to show the group as a zone. The bridge itself is not changed.

room_select.title: Sensors in rooms
room_select.description: Pick a room to attach motion and temperature sensors to it.

room_sensors.title: {room}
room_sensors.description: Motion sensors show presence on the room card. Temperature sensors are averaged into the room temperature; a Hue motion sensor's own thermometer can be combined with the room's thermostat. Light sensors show how bright the room is. Without a choice, the room's Hue sensors are used.

alignment.title: Rooms follow areas
alignment.description: Hue Studio can keep the Hue rooms on the bridge in line with the Home Assistant areas (the panel's "Rooms and zones" screen shows what would change). With this on, every change of an area, or of the area of a Hue light, is written to the bridge at once. Empty Hue rooms are never deleted automatically.

error.area_taken: Another Hue room or zone already belongs to this area.

abort.no_groups: No Hue rooms, zones or areas with Hue lights were found.
